metadata.title: MoroccoTravelRide: tourist transfers in Morocco
metadata.description: Book city and intercity transfers with licensed tourist transport companies in Morocco, at a fixed price.

hero.title: Your transfers in Morocco, booked with confidence
hero.subtitle: Airports, hotels, cities: licensed tourist transport companies and fixed prices known in advance.

licensed.title: Licensed carriers
licensed.text: Every company is verified before it appears on the platform.

fixedPrice.title: Fixed prices
fixedPrice.text: The price you see is the price you pay, with no hidden fees.

cancellation.title: Flexible cancellation
cancellation.text: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before pickup.

payment.title: Easy payment
payment.text: By bank transfer before the ride or in cash to the driver.

empty.title: Your workspace is ready
empty.text: Today's trips, bookings to accept and your alerts will appear here.

companies.title: Companies
companies.noDocuments: No document uploaded yet (onboarding comes in the next step).
companies.commissionHint: Leave empty to apply the platform default rate ({rate} %).
companies.verifyConfirm: The company can appear on the marketplace if it has turned its visibility on.
companies.suspendConfirm: The company will see a suspension banner and disappear from the marketplace.
companies.reopenConfirm: The company goes back to awaiting verification.
companies.liftConfirm: The company can appear on the marketplace again.
companies.suspendMarketplaceConfirm: The company will be hidden from the marketplace until the suspension is lifted. Reason: {reason}
companies.approveConfirm: The document will be marked as approved.
companies.rejectConfirm: The carrier will see the reason and can upload a new document.

settings.title: Settings
settings.paymentHint: Shown to carriers on their subscription page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.

signup.title: Register my transport company
signup.subtitle: Create your account. Our team will verify your company and license before it appears on the marketplace.
signup.acceptTerms: I accept the terms of use
signup.successText: If this address can be used, you will receive a link to confirm your account.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your e-mail address: we will send you a reset link.
forgot.successText: If an account exists for this address, a reset link has just been sent.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.enrollIntro: Access to the administration requires an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password...).
mfa.scan: Scan this QR code with your app, then enter the code it shows.
mfa.challengeIntro: Enter the code shown by your authenticator app.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your e-mail address with the link you received first.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.captcha: The anti-bot check failed. Try again.
errors.link: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

validation.passwordLower: Add at least one lowercase letter.
validation.passwordUpper: Add at least one uppercase letter.
validation.acceptTerms: You must accept the terms of use.

pending.title: Company awaiting verification
pending.text: Our team is checking your details and license. You can already set up your workspace; the marketplace opens after approval.

suspended.title: Company suspended
suspended.text: Your account is suspended. Please contact the MoroccoTravelRide team.

none.title: No company linked
none.text: Your account is not linked to any active company. Contact your company owner.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.pending: This document is being drafted and will be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.

subscription.howToTitle: Change plan or activate your subscription
subscription.howToText: Payment is made by bank transfer. Contact the MoroccoTravelRide team: we send you the invoice and activate the plan as soon as the transfer is received.

onboarding.intro: Four steps so our team can verify your company.

company.title: Company details
company.text: Legal identifiers, address and tourist transport license.

documents.title: License and documents
documents.text: Upload your license (required) and your insurance certificate.

vehicle.title: First vehicle
vehicle.text: Add a vehicle of your fleet.

driver.title: First driver
driver.text: Add a driver of your team.

onboarding.completedText: Your file is complete. Our team will verify it; your company status will show in your workspace.
onboarding.officeOnly: Only the owner and the manager can set up the workspace.

errors.inUse: This item is used elsewhere: deactivate it instead.

setStatusHelp.inactive: The vehicle will no longer be offered for assignments. Its history is kept.

setStatusHelp.inactive: The driver can no longer be assigned. Their history is kept.

setStatusHelp.inactive: The client will no longer be offered. Their trips and invoices are kept.
